Saudi Arabia’s Civil Defence says at least 11 people were injured in a Houthi attack on a tower in Riyadh’s financial district.
Six oil tankers have been hit in the Strait of Hormuz over the past 24 hours after striking mines, Iran’s army and IRGC Navy report.
